evidence.title: GitHub - NiazMorshed2007/shadcn-tiptap: Sets of custom extensions & toolbars for tiptap editor. Install with shadcn/cli. · GitHub

name: Shadcn tiptap
summary: Custom Tiptap rich-text editor extensions and toolbar components for shadcn/ui, installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: A set of custom extensions and toolbar components for the Tiptap rich-text editor, built to be used with shadcn/ui components and installed with the shadcn CLI. The demo app is a Next.js project styled with Tailwind CSS; the set covers editor extensions plus the shadcn-styled toolbar UI. Demo at tiptap.niazmorshed.dev; MIT licensed.
contains: custom Tiptap extensions ready to use with shadcn/ui components
Next.js demo app with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
